/usr/bin/ruby -rjson -rdigest -e 'root="/private/tmp/crystal-click-w267-native.HpgrTG"
s=JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(root,"summary.json")))
raise "qualification status" unless s.fetch("status")=="stock_basic_compact_and_generated_four_cell_matrix_observed"
raw_files=0
s.fetch("invocations").each do |r|
  %w[argv stdin stdout stderr].each do |kind|
    path=File.join(root,"invocations",r.fetch(kind+"_file"))
    raise "raw scope" unless File.realpath(path).start_with?(root+"/") && !File.symlink?(path)
    raise "raw hash" unless Digest::SHA256.file(path).hexdigest==r.fetch(kind+"_sha256")
    raise "raw size" if kind!="argv" && File.size(path)!=r.fetch(kind+"_bytes")
    raw_files+=1
  end
  raise "process infra" if r.fetch("timed_out") || r["signal"] || %w[spawn_error stdin_write_error stdout_read_error stderr_read_error].any?{|k|r[k]}
  raise "process bound" unless r.fetch("timeout_seconds")==10 && r.fetch("required_outer_run_safe_memory_limit_bytes")==12288*1024*1024
  raise "native bound" if r.fetch("max_memory_usage_applicable") && (r.fetch("max_threads")!=1 || r.fetch("max_memory_usage_bytes")!=512*1024*1024)
  raise "identity" unless r.fetch("binary_sha_before")==r.fetch("expected_binary_sha256") && r.fetch("binary_sha_after")==r.fetch("expected_binary_sha256")
end
s.fetch("source_hashes").each{|p,h|raise "source drift" unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==h}
def inventory!(path, want)
  raise "file roster" unless Dir.children(path).sort==want.fetch("files").map{|e|e.fetch("path")}.sort
  want.fetch("files").each do |e|
    p=File.join(path,e.fetch("path"))
    raise "part file identity" unless File.file?(p) && !File.symlink?(p) && File.size(p)==e.fetch("size") && Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==e.fetch("sha256")
  end
end
def u64(bytes,p)
  raise "truncated u64" if p<0 || p>bytes.bytesize-8
  bytes.byteslice(p,8).unpack1("Q<")
end
def raw_and_frames(path)
  data=File.binread(File.join(path,"data.bin")); raw="".b; frames={}
  co=0
  while co<data.bytesize
    raise "frame header" if co>data.bytesize-25 || data.getbyte(co+16)!=0x82
    cs=data.byteslice(co+17,4).unpack1("V"); size=data.byteslice(co+21,4).unpack1("V")
    raise "frame bounds" if cs<9 || co+16+cs>data.bytesize || raw.bytesize+size>64*1024*1024
    input=data.byteslice(co+25,cs-9); output="".b; p=0
    while p<input.bytesize
      token=input.getbyte(p); p+=1; literals=token>>4
      if literals==15
        loop do
          raise "literal extension" if p>=input.bytesize
          n=input.getbyte(p); p+=1; literals+=n; break if n!=255
        end
      end
      raise "literal extent" if literals>input.bytesize-p
      output << input.byteslice(p,literals); p+=literals
      break if p==input.bytesize
      raise "match offset" if p>input.bytesize-2
      distance=input.byteslice(p,2).unpack1("v"); p+=2; count=(token&15)+4
      if (token&15)==15
        loop do
          raise "match extension" if p>=input.bytesize
          n=input.getbyte(p); p+=1; count+=n; break if n!=255
        end
      end
      raise "match extent" if distance.zero? || distance>output.bytesize || count>size-output.bytesize
      count.times { output << output.getbyte(output.bytesize-distance) }
    end
    raise "decoded frame size" unless output.bytesize==size
    frames[co]=[raw.bytesize,size]; raw << output; co+=16+cs
  end
  raise "frame EOF" unless co==data.bytesize
  [data,raw,frames]
end
def grid!(path, mode, slots, report, data, raw, frames)
